title: Titanium(III) configuration
statement:
Enter the ground-state electron configuration of Ti³⁺.

[________]{a}
hints: Count 22 electrons for the neutral atom.
Remove the two electrons from the highest n.
solution: Neutral Ti is $[\mathrm{Ar}]3d^24s^2$. Remove both 4s electrons, then one 3d electron to obtain $[\mathrm{Ar}]3d^1$.
